name: tia_import_plc_type
description: Import or update a PLC User Data Type (UDT) from SimaticML XML, given inline (xml_content) or as a server-local .xml file (file_path). Importing under a new name creates a second type; use tia_rename_plc_type to rename.

xml_content.description: The SimaticML XML string containing the UDT definition. Use this or file_path, not both.

file_path.description: Fully qualified server-local path to a SimaticML .xml file of the UDT (e.g. one written by tia_export_project_files). Use this or xml_content, not both.

plc_name.description: Name of the target PLC (optional, defaults to first PLC).

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite existing UDT (default true).
